defs.def: below the surface of sth; covered by sth 在 … 表面下；由 … 覆盖着

ex.s: Children under 12 years accompanied by an adult are admitted free.
ex.t: 12岁以下由成人陪同的儿童免费入场。

ex.s: Apart from the thrill of those first heart-stopping dives, which, ironically, saved me from going under, what has drawn me is this community of generous, open-hearted souls.
ex.t: 除了那些最初令人心跳加速的跳水带来的刺激——讽刺的是，正是这些跳水救了我免于沉沦——真正吸引我的是这个由慷慨、心胸开阔的人们组成的社区。

ex.s: Volunteers under the age of 18 must have the parent/guardian approval section signed.
ex.t: 未满18岁的志愿者必须由家长/监护人签字批准。

defs.def: less than; younger than 少于；小于；不足；比 … 年轻
由 … 控制（或管理、经营）

ex.s: His parents were not quite able to keep theirs under control.
ex.t: 他的父母不太能够控制住自己的情绪。

ex.s: Make joint efforts to keep it under control.
ex.t: 共同努力将其置于掌控之下。

defs.def: according to an agreement, a law or a system 根据，按照（协议、法律或制度）

ex.s: Under this Act, all waterfowl hunters 16 years of age and over must annually purchase and carry a Federal Duck Stamp.
ex.t: 根据该法案，所有16岁及以上的水禽猎人每年必须购买并携带一张联邦鸭票。

defs.def: using a particular name 用，以（某一名字）

ex.s: Benjamin could read only a little,having been a poor student.But he later said,”Those two books were my companions by day,and under my pillow at night.”While it is likely that he understood very little of the books,they were his introduction to classical paintings.The nine-year-old boy decided then that he would be an artist.
ex.t: 本杰明只读过一点书，因为他曾是个差学生。但他后来说：“那两本书白天是我的伙伴，晚上就在我的枕头下。”虽然他很可能几乎看不懂那些书，但它们是他接触古典绘画的入门。这个九岁男孩当时就下定决心要成为一名艺术家。
